items.headline: Iran ka F-16 dava, America ne kharij kiya
items.detail: Iran ki sena ne dava kiya uski vayu raksha ne Khadi ke upar Americi F-16 par missile daagi aur use emergency landing karni padi; CENTCOM ne dava ko jhootha bataya, kaha koi F-16 par hamla hua hi nahi.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America tanav, Khadi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Sudan me drone hamle: 2,230 nagrik mare
items.detail: UN Human Rights Office ki report ke anusar Sudan me January se October 2026 tak 2,230 se zyada nagrik mare gaye, jinme 1,630 se zyada drone hamlo me mare; drone yuddh ki sabse badi pehchan ban gaye hain.
items.exam_angle: Sudan yuddh, drone, manavadhikar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hormuz me tanker mine se takraya, aag lagi
items.detail: Iran ki nausena ke anusar Hormuz ke poorv me ek tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag ki lapeton me aa gaya; UKMTO ne Oman ke paas do tankeron par hamle ki bhi khabar di.
items.exam_angle: Strait of Hormuz, tel vyapar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Iraq ki sena Kataib Hezbollah ke gadh me ghusi
items.detail: Samjhaute ke baad Iraqi suraksha balon ne Baghdad ke dakshin me Jurf al-Sakhar me pravesh kiya; Kataib Hezbollah ek mahine ke andar wahan se hatne par raazi hua, tel taskari ke aaropon ke beech.
items.exam_angle: Iraq, Iran-samarthit milicia — UPSC IR

items.headline: COP31 ke naye draft se jeevashm-indhan zikr hata
items.detail: COP31 ke sanshodhit draft me jeevashm indhan se door hatne aur 120 arab dollar ke jalvayu vitt ka zikr hata diya gaya; 2035 tak bijli ki hissedari 35% karne ka lakshya barkarar hai.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu vitt — UPSC Environment

items.headline: Kryvyi Rih par triple-tap hamla, bachcha mara
items.detail: Russia ke hamle me Kryvyi Rih me saat saal ka bachcha aur ek paramedic mare gaye, lagbhag 60 log ghayal hue; Zelensky ne ise aam nagrik ilake par hamla bataya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: UN: killer robot par niyam 2028 tak
items.detail: Geneva me 128 deshon ne sahmati di ki ghatak swayatt hathiyaron par sambhavit niyam 2028 tak taiyar kiye jayenge; badhyakari niyamon par sahmati nahi bani.
items.exam_angle: UN CCW, swayatt hathiyar — UPSC IR/S&T

items.headline: EU ka Big Tech par 3% tax prastav
items.detail: European Council ke pramukh Antonio Costa ne 2028-2034 ke budget ke liye badi digital companies par 3% levy ka prastav diya; 204 arab euro ki katauti bhi prastavit hai, samjhauta December tak chahiye.
items.exam_angle: EU budget, digital tax, Big Tech — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: Videsh data centre par Trump ki tax-dhamki
items.detail: Rashtrapati Trump ne kaha videsh me data centre banane wali Americi companies par 'tremendous tax' lagega; AI me China se aage rehne ke liye desh ke andar nivesh chahiye.
items.exam_angle: America, AI, data centre, China — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: IRGC ka dava: Hormuz me US drone giraya
items.detail: Iran ke IRGC ne dava kiya uski vayu raksha ne Hormuz me ek MQ-9 aur Qeshm ke upar ek MQ-1 drone giraya; America ne abhi iski koi pushti nahi ki hai.
items.exam_angle: Iran-America tanav, Hormuz — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gulf of Finland me Russian jahaz par hamla
items.detail: Kaliningrad ja raha Russian cargo jahaz Sparta II Finland ki khaadi me do drone hamle ke baad aag ki lapet me aaya; chaalak dal ko nikala ja raha hai, Finland ki sena ne bhi hamle ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Baltic, Russia-Ukraine yuddh, samudri suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: China ke Qinghai me 5.6 teevrata ka bhukamp
items.detail: Delingha ke paas bhukamp aaya — China ke CENC ke anusar 5.6 aur GFZ ke anusar 5.8 teevrata; gehrai 10 km, jhatke Delingha me zor se mehsoos hue, nuksan aur hatahat ki jaanch jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Bhukamp, China — UPSC Geography

items.headline: Hormuz ke paas doosre tanker par hamla
items.detail: UKMTO ke anusar Hormuz se nikalte doosre tanker ko engine room me ajnabee projectile laga, Khasab se 17 nautical miles poorv; Iran ki nausena ne kaha ek tanker restricted area me mine se takraya, par ye pushti nahi hui ki dono ek hi ghatna hain.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz, urja suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza me Israeli hamle me teen ki maut
items.detail: Gaza City ke Tel al-Hawa me Israeli yuddh vimanon ne ek gaadi par bam giraya, teen log mare gaye aur kai ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Gaza, Israel-Palestine — UPSC IR

items.headline: Haiti me visfotak se teen Salvadoran sainik mare
items.detail: El Salvador ki sena ke anusar Haiti me visfotak sambhalte samay dhamake me teen sainik mare gaye aur ek ghayal hua; October ke ant se tainat lagbhag 2,500 sainikon me ye pehli maut hai.
items.exam_angle: Haiti sankat, videshi sainya hastakshep — UPSC IR

items.headline: Thailand-Philippines se Trump ke vyapar samjhaute
items.detail: Trump ne Asia yatra ke baad ghoshna ki: Thailand 99% Americi niryat par shulk khatm karega aur har saal 2.6 arab dollar ke krishi utpad kharidega; Philippines 20 Boeing 787 kharidega — kul 17 arab dollar se zyada ke saude.
items.exam_angle: America-ASEAN vyapar, shulk neeti — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: America ke cyber pramukh hate, Davies ko zimma
items.detail: White House ne National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross ko desh bhar me takniki kharabi aur outage ke baad pad se hata diya; Pentagon CIO Kirsten Davies karyavahak nideshak bani hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki cyber suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hormuz me tanker par hamla, koi ghayal nahi
items.detail: Hormuz se bahar ja rahe tanker ko Khasab se 11 nautical miles uttar ajnabee projectile laga; UKMTO ke anusar koi ghayal nahi hua, paryavaran par asar abhi agyaat hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jaladmarumadhya, urja suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: COP31 samay se aage, jeevashm indhan par atka
items.detail: Antalya me COP31 vaarta 21 November tak badh gayi; naya masuda jeevashm indhan ka zikr hata deta hai aur 120 arab dollar ki anukoolan vitt ki rakam bhi gayab hai — teesra masuda aaj aayega.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu vitt, jeevashm indhan — UPSC Environment

items.headline: Bangladesh me aagjani badhi, Grameen Bank nishane par
items.detail: Hasina ki wapsi ko lekar Bangladesh me aagjani aur hamle badhe, Grameen Bank ki 72 shakhaon par hamla hua aur 124 log giraftar hue.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh ki rajneeti, Bharat se sambandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Basra me gas pipeline phati, chaar ki maut
items.detail: Basra ke Hartha power station ke paas gas pipeline phatne se aag lag gayi, kam se kam chaar ki maut aur 35 ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Iraq, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: Europe bhar me Gen Z ke virodh pradarshan
items.detail: 25 se zyada deshon me yuvaon ne mehengaai, kiraye, shiksha aur sainya kharch ke khilaf ek saath pradarshan kiye; France me shanivar ko 70,000 police tainat, Italy me aam hadtaal hui.
items.exam_angle: Europe, cost-of-living crisis, yuva virodh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Houthi missile Riyadh ki ore, Saudi ne roki
items.detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne Riyadh ki taraf daage gaye teen ballistic missile giraye; isse pehle Hodeidah bandargah aur Sanaa me Houthi thikanon par hamle hue.
items.exam_angle: Yemen yuddh, Houthi, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: Ramallah me basti guard ne ek ko maara
items.detail: Beit El basti ke suraksha guard ne Dura al-Qar gaon ke paas 42 saal ke Hamza Masoud Salim Abdo ko goli maari; shav roka gaya aur doosra vyakti giraftar hua.
items.exam_angle: West Bank, Israel-Palestine — UPSC IR
